_provenance.digestAlgorithm: sha256 over the vendored content bytes (the `reasonGlossary` value re-serialized)
_provenance.refreshProtocol: bump scripts/vendor-fixtures.ts <artifact>.repoCommit to the pinned upstream SHA, then rerun; commit artifact + digest together
_provenance.note: machine-readable extraction of the landed contracts reason-glossary table (symbol, code, what-was-attempted, per-observer guidance, SPEC ref); the SDK's explainReason parity test consumes it as the reason-vocabulary source (SDK issue #38)

reasonGlossary.description: Machine-readable extraction of the guard contract's reason glossary (docs/reason-glossary.md): one entry per blocked reason with its Error code, what was attempted, and per-observer guidance. Consumed by the SDK's explainReason parity test (SDK issue #38).

unauthorized.what_was_attempted: A transaction signed by a key that does not match the registered `AgentPubkey`, or an admin call not authenticated as the admin.
unauthorized.agent_guidance: Stop: signing key or host payload does not match registration. Re-derive, verify nonce/expiry, escalate. Never try alternate keys to force a pass.
unauthorized.operator_action: Re-register the intended key via `rotate_agent_key`, or re-provision credentials. If intermittent, inspect node time and reserved-nonce handling.
unauthorized.auditor_note: Records a key/signature mismatch at the account; investigate any recurrence.

already_initialized.agent_guidance: Not agent-facing; if tooling surfaces it, treat as an idempotency note, not an error.
already_initialized.operator_action: None; the account is already initialized.
already_initialized.auditor_note: Documents a double-init attempt (usually benign automation).

not_initialized.operator_action: Run `initialize` with the admin and the registered agent key.
not_initialized.auditor_note: Marks the pre-activation window where all calls were default-denied.

invalid_config.what_was_attempted: `set_policy` given a config that fails §8 validation.
invalid_config.operator_action: Correct the config per §8 (e.g. `window_cap != 0` requires `window_secs != 0`; no self-address in `assets`/`protocols`; no duplicate addresses) and re-apply.
invalid_config.auditor_note: The proposed policy was refused; the on-chain policy is unchanged (fail-closed).

invalid_amount.agent_guidance: Fix the caller: zero/negative amounts are a client bug, not a policy limit.
invalid_amount.operator_action: Check the agent's code path is not emitting non-positive amounts; high frequency = noisy client.
invalid_amount.auditor_note: Attests the account never admits a non-positive transfer.

no_pending_admin.operator_action: Propose first (`propose_admin_rotation`), or check whether a concurrent operator already confirmed/cancelled.
no_pending_admin.auditor_note: Records an out-of-order rotation attempt; admin, policy, and revision are unchanged.

admin_frozen.what_was_attempted: Any spend or heartbeat while the admin kill switch is set.
admin_frozen.agent_guidance: Halt immediately; do not retry until the operator clears. Heartbeat is blocked too — escalate.
admin_frozen.operator_action: Establish why the freeze was set, then `unfreeze()` (also re-arms `LastHeartbeat`).
admin_frozen.auditor_note: A hard stop; the later `unfrozen` event is the admin's recovery attestation.

heartbeat_expired.what_was_attempted: Any call after the dead-man grace elapsed (agent silent longer than `dms_grace_secs`).
heartbeat_expired.agent_guidance: Cannot self-recover; notify the operator immediately and stop operations.
heartbeat_expired.operator_action: Verify agent liveness, then `unfreeze()` to re-arm `LastHeartbeat`; consider raising `dms_grace_secs`.
heartbeat_expired.auditor_note: Proves the dead-man switch fired for the recorded silence window; reconcile with policy.

no_policy.what_was_attempted: Any spend while no policy is installed (revoked or never set).
no_policy.agent_guidance: Cease — default-deny is by design; request a policy from the operator.
no_policy.auditor_note: At revoke time default-deny held; the later `policy_set` event is the record.

paused.agent_guidance: Suspend activity and poll `status()` at a reasonable interval until `paused` clears; do not route around.
paused.operator_action: Resume via `set_policy` with `paused = false` after maintenance.
paused.auditor_note: Operator kill-switch usage; pairs with the re-open event.

outside_active_window.agent_guidance: Wait for the activity window; schedule operations inside it.
outside_active_window.operator_action: Correct the window bounds via `set_policy` if the timetable changed.
outside_active_window.auditor_note: Attests spend stays within the declared activity window at T.

asset_not_allowed.what_was_attempted: SAC transfer on an asset not in `assets`.
asset_not_allowed.agent_guidance: Only operate on policy-listed assets; read `policy()` before choosing.
asset_not_allowed.operator_action: Add the asset to `assets` if it is intended (admin-attested change).

recipient_not_allowed.what_was_attempted: SAC transfer to a recipient not in `recipients` (and not covered by `allow_any_recipient`).
recipient_not_allowed.operator_action: Add the recipient, or consciously enable `allow_any_recipient`.

per_tx_cap_exceeded.agent_guidance: Halt and escalate; do not retry immediately. Never split one intended payment into multiple smaller ones to dodge the cap — that is evasion and unsupported.
per_tx_cap_exceeded.operator_action: Raise `per_tx_cap` if the business need genuinely grew, or restate the limit.
per_tx_cap_exceeded.auditor_note: Per-tx bound held at T (event + tx reference).

window_cap_exceeded.what_was_attempted: A transfer that would push the rolling-window total over `window_cap`.
window_cap_exceeded.agent_guidance: Wait for window entries to expire (`window_secs`) before retrying; escalate. Do not re-route spend outside the accounting path to evade the window.
window_cap_exceeded.operator_action: Raise `window_cap` if legitimately needed, or reset cadence expectations.
window_cap_exceeded.auditor_note: Rolling cap held over the [T − `window_secs`, T] span (invariant, §3.1).

protocol_not_allowed.what_was_attempted: A call to a contract not in `protocols`.
protocol_not_allowed.operator_action: Add the protocol to the allowlist if intended.

function_not_allowed.what_was_attempted: A call to a function not in the protocol's `fns` list.
function_not_allowed.operator_action: Extend the per-protocol `fns` list if intended.

asset_fn_not_allowed.what_was_attempted: A call to a listed SAC function other than `transfer` or `transfer_from`.
asset_fn_not_allowed.agent_guidance: Use only the SAC transfer functions supported by the policy; do not attempt a different asset operation.
asset_fn_not_allowed.operator_action: Use an admin-approved path if the asset operation is intended; the guard does not authorize SAC minting or burning.
asset_fn_not_allowed.auditor_note: Records that a non-transfer function on a listed asset was denied.

unknown_contract.what_was_attempted: A call to a contract that is neither this account, an allowlisted asset, nor an allowlisted protocol.
unknown_contract.agent_guidance: Unknown contracts are default-deny in v1; consult `policy()` and do not attempt workarounds.
unknown_contract.operator_action: Allowlist the contract if it should be callable under v1 intent.

self_function_not_allowed.what_was_attempted: A call to one of the account's own functions outside the agent-allowed path (only `heartbeat` — and the `check` pre-flight — are agent-facing).
self_function_not_allowed.agent_guidance: The agent may only call its own `heartbeat`; management functions belong to the admin seat.
self_function_not_allowed.operator_action: Use the admin path for management; align tooling, no contract change needed.
self_function_not_allowed.auditor_note: Records the self-call surface being contained to the heartbeat/check path.

create_contract_not_allowed.agent_guidance: The account never authorizes contract creation in v1 — route creation to a dedicated operator-owned account.
create_contract_not_allowed.operator_action: Create contracts from a non-guarded account.
create_contract_not_allowed.auditor_note: Proves the account never authorizes creation.

recipient_blocked.what_was_attempted: SAC transfer to an explicitly blocked recipient.
recipient_blocked.agent_guidance: Do not retry to disguise the destination; stop and escalate.
recipient_blocked.operator_action: Remove the denylist entry only if policy intent changed.
recipient_blocked.auditor_note: The explicit recipient denylist blocked this destination.

protocol_call_rate_exceeded.what_was_attempted: An allowlisted protocol call exceeds its rolling-window call limit.
protocol_call_rate_exceeded.agent_guidance: Wait for calls in the rolling window to expire; do not route around the configured protocol limit.
protocol_call_rate_exceeded.operator_action: Raise `protocol_calls_per_window` only if justified by policy.
protocol_call_rate_exceeded.auditor_note: Records the configured auth-context protocol call limit enforcing the rate bound.

decision_invariant_violation.what_was_attempted: Internal verdict data was inconsistent (empty result for a submitted preflight call, invalid context index, or a blocked result without a reason).
decision_invariant_violation.agent_guidance: Stop and escalate; do not retry around the contract error.
decision_invariant_violation.operator_action: Report the contract version and transaction details to maintainers.
decision_invariant_violation.auditor_note: Signals an enforcement implementation invariant failure; preserve the failed transaction diagnostics.

too_many_auth_contexts.what_was_attempted: One authorization contains more than the fixed 64-context engine bound.
too_many_auth_contexts.agent_guidance: Do not split or reroute the batch to evade the bound; reduce the intended authorization only if its policy meaning is unchanged, otherwise escalate.
too_many_auth_contexts.operator_action: Review the router batch size and transaction design; the contract limit is fixed, not policy-configurable.
too_many_auth_contexts.auditor_note: The engine rejected the whole authorization before parsing contexts or staging window admissions.
